home.heroTitle: Quality Secondary Care, Accessible to All, Free of Charge
home.heroText: Serving Bapatla and rural Andhra Pradesh with specialist care — completely free for everyone.
home.heroImageAlt: A doctor consulting an elderly patient at Sai Aarogya Hospital
home.quickTitle: How can we help you today?
home.quickDoctor: See specialists and their visiting days
home.departmentsIntro: Sai Aarogya Hospital - Bapatla is your one-stop solution for quality healthcare. Our skilled doctors offer a wide range of services, from general care to specialised treatments like dentistry and paediatrics and more – all absolutely free.
home.doctorsIntro: Resident doctors and visiting consultants across our specialities.
home.networkIntro: Sai Aarogya Hospital works alongside other healthcare initiatives of the Sri Madhusudan Sai Global Humanitarian Mission.
home.supportTitle: Help us keep care free for everyone
home.supportText: Your support helps us provide free, high-quality healthcare to underserved communities across India.
